library.name: approdyn
library.description: The APPRODYN feedwater test case (Aubry et al., 2012), discrete part, as a component type library.

types.name: PowerCycle
types.description: The power profile of scenario 1: ramps, plateau, forced return to 60 % after the loss of a turbo-pump at power, ramp down. Its takeovers wait for a running turbo-pump and the valve that serves next. It publishes every set of phases a neighbour reads.

parameters.name: ramp_0_2
parameters.description: Rise from 0 to 2 %, in h.

parameters.name: ramp_2_15
parameters.description: Rise from 2 to 15 %, in h.

parameters.name: ramp_15_60
parameters.description: Rise from 15 to 60 %, in h.

parameters.name: ramp_60_100
parameters.description: Rise from 60 to 100 %, in h.

parameters.name: ramp_down
parameters.description: Ramp down, in h.

parameters.name: forcing_pfd
parameters.description: Failure of the forced return to 60 %, per demand.

types.name: Calendar
types.description: The end of the full-power plateau.

parameters.name: plateau_end
parameters.description: Date the plateau ends, in h.

types.name: SteamHeader
types.description: The VVP steam header: any failure trips the plant.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Failure rate, in 1/h.

types.name: ExtractionPump
types.description: A CEX extraction pump, running or in standby: started on demand (it may refuse) when fewer than two run and no earlier pump stands by, repaired back to standby. A common-cause failure raises the plant's `cex_ccf` condition through `cex_ccf_in`.

parameters.name: running
parameters.description: Whether the pump runs at the start (else it stands by).

parameters.name: fail_rate
parameters.description: Running failure rate (72 h repair), in 1/h.

parameters.name: rupture_rate
parameters.description: Running rupture rate (168 h repair), in 1/h.

parameters.name: pfd
parameters.description: Refusal to start, per demand.

parameters.name: ccf
parameters.description: Whether 5 % of the running failures are common-cause.

parameters.name: ccf_rate
parameters.description: Common-cause failure rate, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep72
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep72`, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep168
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep168`, in 1/h.

types.name: TurboPump
types.description: A TPA turbo-pump, the series of its turbine and out-of-turbine parts: started on demand when fewer run than the power phase requires (it may refuse, into one of three repair states), failing while running, repaired back to standby. A refusal while forced at 60 % raises the plant's `tpa_refused_at_60` condition, a common-cause failure its `tpa_ccf` condition, both through ports. `perfect` is the diagnostic turbo-pump that always starts and never fails.

parameters.name: p_ht
parameters.description: Start refused by the out-of-turbine part (28 h repair).

parameters.name: p_t_short
parameters.description: Start refused by the turbine, short repair (2 h).

parameters.name: p_t_long
parameters.description: Start refused by the turbine, long repair (24 h).

parameters.name: fail_long_rate
parameters.description: Running failure rate with a 24 h repair, in 1/h.

parameters.name: fail_short_rate
parameters.description: Running failure rate with a 2 h repair, in 1/h.

parameters.name: rupture_rate
parameters.description: Running rupture rate (144 h repair), in 1/h.

parameters.name: ccf
parameters.description: Whether 5 % of the running failures are common-cause.

parameters.name: ccf_rate
parameters.description: Common-cause failure rate, in 1/h.

parameters.name: perfect
parameters.description: The diagnostic turbo-pump: always starts, never fails.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep2
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep2`, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep24
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep24`, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep28
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep28`, in 1/h.

parameters.name: repair_rate_rep144
parameters.description: Repair rate out of `rep144`, in 1/h.

types.name: FeedwaterValve
types.description: An ARE regulating valve: opens when the power phase it takes over in begins (it may refuse, and is then repaired), and while in service fails into a trip at a rate set by the trip rule.

parameters.name: p_refuse
parameters.description: Refusal to open, per demand.

parameters.name: repair_rate
parameters.description: Repair rate after a refusal, in 1/h.

parameters.name: trip_rate
parameters.description: Rate of the failures in service that trip the plant, in 1/h.

types.name: Plant
types.description: The latched trip conditions, written by the pumps through their ports and read by the trip logic.

types.name: TripLogic
types.description: The first trip and its cause; each cause is a target, so a history stops at the first trip.
